cover_letter:
Dear iO Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Advertising Specialist position at iO. Your description of an individual passionate about advertising and marketing campaigns, driven by data, and providing proactive, thorough advice resonates strongly with my professional approach and capabilities.

My experience developing and implementing digital strategies, particularly in my freelance work and as a Junior Digital Marketer, has instilled a methodical approach to campaign planning and execution. While my focus has primarily been on organic growth, the underlying principles of keyword research, content optimization, and technical SEO for measurably raising search health scores translate directly to understanding and enhancing the performance of paid advertising initiatives. My Google Ads Search Certification further solidifies my foundation in managing and optimizing campaigns effectively.

I am highly proficient in utilizing analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs. I consistently leverage these platforms to analyze campaign results, track performance, and generate concrete recommendations for improvement, a skill directly aligned with your reporting and data analysis requirements. This data-driven mindset extends to budget management, where my analytical eye would ensure responsible allocation and optimization to maximize client ROI.

Client relationship management has been a cornerstone of my career, from building websites for businesses around Antwerp to managing content for diverse client portfolios. I enjoy serving as a bridge between technical execution and client goals, proactively brainstorming solutions that genuinely serve their business interests. Whether for international companies or SMEs, I am confident in my ability to manage a diverse client set and apply a business-minded perspective to every campaign.

I am excited by the prospect of bringing my blend of analytical insight, technical understanding, and client-focused approach to iO. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to discussing how my skills and enthusiasm can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Google Ads Search Certification, complemented by expertise in Google Analytics and Google Search Console for campaign analysis and reporting.
• Proven ability to leverage analytics tools (Google Analytics, Semrush, Ahrefs) for data-driven insights and concrete recommendations to enhance campaign performance.
• Experience in designing, building, and optimizing websites (WordPress, Shopify) for clients, ensuring content and technical SEO support measurable growth.
• Strong background in client relationship management, providing proactive support and tailoring strategies to meet diverse business objectives for both SMEs and larger entities.
• Solid technical SEO knowledge, including keyword research, structured data, and audit execution, offering a robust understanding of how to optimize online visibility.
